analogy: Neuroplasticity + adult neurogenesis applied to Cam's Brodmann mesh

literature.cite: Hebbian LTP/LTD and three-factor plasticity (Annu Rev Neurosci — synaptic plasticity forms)
literature.use: strengthen co-active tract synapses; depress unused; eligibility traces on mesh writes

literature.cite: Synaptic pruning / experience-dependent homeostasis (Neural Regen Res reviews)
literature.use: prune weak tract edges after repeated LTD or QA veto; keep excitation/inhibition balance

literature.cite: Adult hippocampal neurogenesis — granule cell integration & enhanced early LTP (CSH Perspectives)
literature.use: spawn immature MTL columns that mature into mesh-capable neurons over cycles

literature.cite: Structural homo-/heterosynaptic spine plasticity in adult-born GCs (PNAS)
literature.use: homosynaptic enlarge on act pathway; heterosynaptic shrink on competing unused tracts

ltp.effect: increase tract weight along used edges

ltd.effect: decrease tract weight on failed/error segments

pruning.effect: mark tract segment pruned — router prefers alternate short path

homeostasis.effect: synaptic scaling — dampen all local column gains in area
homeostasis.notes: Keeps E/I balance when too many loops fire

neurogenesis.notes: Adult-born MTL columns — high early LTP, then mature into mesh curators

efficiency.notes: Small-world: dense local columns, sparse long tracts — shorter act chains when safe
